answer: A concrete defense is a per-identity stake bond that only unlocks after a long cooldown. Voting weight and reward weight scale with locked stake, so splitting one balance across ten thousand wallets earns the same as one wallet, which removes the payoff. A new wallet must also be vouched by an established member, who loses their ember of standing if the recruit turns fake, leaving a signed relic that exposes rings vouching for each other. Attack cost equals the whole stake repeated per fake plus every voucher's reputation, and the nectar of rewards is clawed back at settlement.
